barrel-extender.name: Barrel Extender
barrel-extender.longDescription: An augmentation which increases the effective range of any ranged weapon.

capacity-expander.name: Capacity Expander
capacity-expander.longDescription: An augmentation which increases the ammo capacity of any ranged weapon, but increases overall volume.

disruptive-coating.name: Disruptive Coating
disruptive-coating.longDescription: An augmentation which increases the shield damage of any ranged weapon.

disruptor-m11-amplifier.name: Disruptor M11 Amplifier
disruptor-m11-amplifier.longDescription: A Disruptor-specific augmentation which increases damage output, but reduces rate of fire.

disruptor-m11-heavy-kit.name: Disruptor M11 Heavy Kit
disruptor-m11-heavy-kit.longDescription: An augmentation for the Disruptor M11 which increases damage and reduces overall volume, but reduces accuracy and ammo capacity.

disruptor-m11-precision-tuning.name: Disruptor M11 Precision Tuning
disruptor-m11-precision-tuning.longDescription: A Disruptor-specific augmentation which increases ammo capacity and accuracy, and reduces recoil, but reduces damage output.

disruptor-m11-quickloader.name: Disruptor M11 Quickloader
disruptor-m11-quickloader.longDescription: An augmentation for the Disruptor M11 which reduces reload times and increases rate of fire, but reduces damage output and accuracy, and increases overall volume.

disruptor-m11-shield-breaker.name: Disruptor M11 Shield Breaker
disruptor-m11-shield-breaker.longDescription: A Disruptor-specific augmentation which increases shield damage and effective range, but reduces rate of fire.

disruptor-m11-sprayer.name: Disruptor M11 Sprayer
disruptor-m11-sprayer.longDescription: An augmentation for the Disruptor M11 which increases ammo capacity and rate of fire, but increases reload times and overall volume.

disruptor-m11-personnel-buster.name: Disruptor M11 Personnel-Buster
disruptor-m11-personnel-buster.longDescription: A Disruptor M11-specific augmentation which increases critical damage and rate of fire, at the cost of shield damage, range, and recoil.

drillshot-fk7-amplifier.name: Drillshot FK7 Amplifier
drillshot-fk7-amplifier.longDescription: An augmentation for the Drillshot FK7 which increases damage and reduces overall volume, but reduces ammo capacity.

drillshot-fk7-optimizer.name: Drillshot FK7 Optimizer
drillshot-fk7-optimizer.longDescription: A Drillshot FK7-specific augmentation which increases damage and reduces recoil, but reduces accuracy.

drillshot-fk7-quickloader.name: Drillshot FK7 Quickloader
drillshot-fk7-quickloader.longDescription: A Drillshot FK7-specific augmentation that reduces reload times, improves headshot damage, and reduces overall volume, but reduces accuracy and ammo capacity and increases recoil.

drillshot-fk7-sprayer.name: Drillshot FK7 Sprayer
drillshot-fk7-sprayer.longDescription: An augmentation for the Drillshot FK7 which increases rate of fire and ammo capacity, but reduces damage output and increases recoil and overall volume.

drillshot-fk7-tactical-adjuster.name: Drillshot FK7 Tactical Adjuster
drillshot-fk7-tactical-adjuster.longDescription: A Drillshot FK7-specific augmentation which increases headshot damage, accuracy, and effective range, but reduces rate of fire.

drillshot-fk7-spray-and-pray.name: Drillshot FK7 Spray-and-Pray
drillshot-fk7-spray-and-pray.longDescription: A Drillshot FK7-specific augmentation which increases reload speed and rate of fire, at the cost of range, recoil, and magazine size.

flamethrower-amplifier.name: Flamethrower Amplifier
flamethrower-amplifier.longDescription: A flamethrower-specific augmentation that increases damage output and reduces recoil, but increases overall volume.

flamethrower-nozzle-extension.name: Flamethrower Nozzle Extension
flamethrower-nozzle-extension.longDescription: A flamethrower-specific augmentation that increases the effective range and ammo capacity at the cost of increased volume and recoil.

flamethrower-quickloader.name: Flamethrower Quickloader
flamethrower-quickloader.longDescription: A flamethrower-specific augmentation that reduces recoil, reload time, and overall volume at the cost of damage output.

flamethrower-superheater.name: Flamethrower Superheater
flamethrower-superheater.longDescription: A flamethrower-specific augmentation that sprays out flames faster and causes more painful burns, but reduces the effective range.

flamethrower-decimator.name: Flamethrower Decimator
flamethrower-decimator.longDescription: A Flamethrower-specific augmentation which offers a massive bonus to shield damage but reduces the rate of fire.

grda-44-amplifier.name: GRDA 44 Amplifier
grda-44-amplifier.longDescription: A GRDA 44-specific augmentation which increases damage output and reduces shot spread, but reduces effective range.

grda-44-expander.name: GRDA 44 Expander
grda-44-expander.longDescription: An augmentation for the GRDA 44 which increases ammo capacity and effective range, but increases shot spread and reduces damage output.

grda-44-micro-rigidity-coating.name: GRDA 44 Micro-Rigidity Coating
grda-44-micro-rigidity-coating.longDescription: An augmentation for the GRDA 44 which increases effective range and accuracy, and reduces recoil and overall volume, but reduces ammo capacity.

grda-44-optimizer.name: GRDA 44 Optimizer
grda-44-optimizer.longDescription: An augmentation for the GRDA 44 which increases damage output, reduces shot spread and overall volume, but at the cost of ammo capacity.

grda-44-sprayer.name: GRDA 44 Sprayer
grda-44-sprayer.longDescription: A GRDA 44-specific augmentation which increases rate of fire, but reduces accuracy and increases recoil and shot spread.

grda-44-tactical-amplifier.name: GRDA 44 Tactical Amplifier
grda-44-tactical-amplifier.longDescription: A GRDA 44-specific augmentation which increases headshot damage, but reduces fire rate.

scattergun-rampage-enhancement.name: Scattergun Rampage-Enhancement
scattergun-rampage-enhancement.longDescription: A Scattergun-specific augmentation which increases damage and magazine size, at the cost of critical hit damage.

heavy-caliber-upgrade.name: Heavy Caliber Upgrade
heavy-caliber-upgrade.longDescription: An augmentation which increases the damage output of any ranged weapon.

jabal-spitdart-amplifier.name: JABAL Spitdart Amplifier
jabal-spitdart-amplifier.longDescription: An augmentation for the JABAL Spitdart Rifle which increases damage, but increases recoil.

jabal-spitdart-disruptive-coating.name: JABAL Spitdart Disruptive Coating
jabal-spitdart-disruptive-coating.longDescription: A JABAL Spitdart Rifle-specific augmentation which increases shield damage, but reduces ammo capacity.

jabal-spitdart-expander.name: JABAL Spitdart Expander
jabal-spitdart-expander.longDescription: An augmentation for JABAL Spitdart Rifles which increases ammo capacity and rate of fire, but reduces effective range, accuracy, and damage output and increases overall volume.

jabal-spitdart-range-adjuster.name: JABAL Spitdart Range Adjuster
jabal-spitdart-range-adjuster.longDescription: A JABAL Spitdart Rifle-specific augmentation which increases accuracy and range, but increases reload times.

jabal-spitdart-tactical-enhancer.name: JABAL Spitdart Tactical Enhancer
jabal-spitdart-tactical-enhancer.longDescription: An augmentation for the JABAL Spitdart Rifle which increases headshot damage, but increases recoil.

jabal-spitdart-toxicity-amplifier.name: JABAL Spitdart Toxicity Amplifier
jabal-spitdart-toxicity-amplifier.longDescription: A JABAL Spitdart Rifle-specific augmentation which increases poison damage dealt, but reduces shield damage dealt.

jabal-spitdart-ranger.name: JABAL Spitdart Ranger
jabal-spitdart-ranger.longDescription: A JABAL Spitdart-specific augmentation which increases reload speed and range, at a cost to the rate of fire.

karpov-38-dart-sprayer.name: Karpov 38 Dart Sprayer
karpov-38-dart-sprayer.longDescription: A Karpov 38-specific augmentation that opts for less power behind each dart in order to fire more darts. This reduces the overall damage of each dart fired but increases the fire rate.

karpov-38-focuser.name: Karpov 38 Focuser
karpov-38-focuser.longDescription: A Karpov 38-specific augmentation which improves accuracy and reload times and reduces recoil, but the overall damage output is reduced.

karpov-38-heavy-kit.name: Karpov 38 Heavy Kit
karpov-38-heavy-kit.longDescription: This Karpov 38-specific augmentation alters the magazine to hold more powerful darts but fewer of them, thus reducing the weapon's overall volume and magazine capacity while improving damage output.

karpov-38-precision-kit.name: Karpov 38 Precision Kit
karpov-38-precision-kit.longDescription: A Karpov 38-specific augmentation which focuses more on dealing critical damage to weak spots en-masse, thus increasing magazine capacity, headshot damage, and overall volume while reducing accuracy.

karpov-38-pressurizer.name: Karpov 38 Pressurizer
karpov-38-pressurizer.longDescription: This Karpov 38-specific augmentation delays the release of fired darts in order to build up additional force, thus reducing the fire rate while increasing the damage output and accuracy.

karpov-38-sniper-barrel.name: Karpov 38 Sniper Barrel
karpov-38-sniper-barrel.longDescription: A Karpov 38-specific augmentation which increases range and accuracy but reduces reload speed.

lasgun-amplifier.name: Lasgun Amplifier
lasgun-amplifier.longDescription: A Lasgun-specific augmentation which increases damage output and reduces overall volume, but reduces range and increases recoil.

lasgun-extender.name: Lasgun Extender
lasgun-extender.longDescription: This Lasgun-specific augmentation increases the range and accuracy of the beam and reduces overall volume, but reduces overall damage output.

lasgun-focuser.name: Lasgun Focuser
lasgun-focuser.longDescription: A Lasgun-specific augmentation which increases the beam's damaging power and reduces overall volume, however the power drain and recoil suffer.

lasgun-harmonizer.name: Lasgun Harmonizer
lasgun-harmonizer.longDescription: An augmentation for Lasguns which increases the rate of fire of the beam, reduces recoil, and reduces power drain, however the range of the beam and its damage output are reduced, and overall volume is increased.

lasgun-concentrator.name: Lasgun Concentrator
lasgun-concentrator.longDescription: A Lasgun-specific augmentation which increases the beam’s damaging power and accuracy but reduces the rate of fire and magazine size.

maula-pistol-barrel-extender.name: Maula Pistol Barrel Extender
maula-pistol-barrel-extender.longDescription: An augmentation for Maula Pistols that increases effective range and accuracy and reduces reload times, but reduces overall rate of fire.

maula-pistol-disruptive-coating.name: Maula Pistol Disruptive Coating
maula-pistol-disruptive-coating.longDescription: This Maula Pistol-specific augmentation increases damage and shield damage and reduces overall volume, but reduces ammo capacity.

maula-pistol-expander.name: Maula Pistol Expander
maula-pistol-expander.longDescription: A Maula Pistol-specific augmentation that expands ammo capacity and increases fire rate, but reduces accuracy and overall damage.

maula-pistol-sprayer.name: Maula Pistol Sprayer
maula-pistol-sprayer.longDescription: A Maula Pistol-specific augmentation which increases fire rate but reduces headshot damage.

maula-pistol-tactical-enhancer.name: Maula Pistol Tactical Enhancer
maula-pistol-tactical-enhancer.longDescription: A Maula Pistol-specific augmentation that reduces recoil and overall volume while also increasing accuracy and headshot damage. However, rate of fire and ammo capacity are reduced.

maula-pistol-antipersonnel-rounds.name: Maula Pistol Antipersonnel Rounds
maula-pistol-antipersonnel-rounds.longDescription: A Maula Pistol-specific augmentation which increases damage and critical damage at the cost of shield damage, range, and recoil.

missile-launcher-disruptive-coating.name: Missile Launcher Disruptive Coating
missile-launcher-disruptive-coating.longDescription: A Missile Launcher-specific augmentation which increases shield damage, but increases reload times.

missile-launcher-fragmenter.name: Missile Launcher Fragmenter
missile-launcher-fragmenter.longDescription: An augmentation for Missile Launchers which increases area of effect and reduces reload times, but reduces shield damage.

missile-launcher-heavy-payload.name: Missile Launcher Heavy Payload
missile-launcher-heavy-payload.longDescription: An augmentation for Missile Launchers which increases their damage output, but reduces shield damage and area of effect.

missile-launcher-quickloader.name: Missile Launcher Quickloader
missile-launcher-quickloader.longDescription: A Missile Launcher-specific augmentation which reduces reload times and recoil and increases accuracy, but reduces overall damage.

missile-launcher-obliterator.name: Missile Launcher Obliterator
missile-launcher-obliterator.longDescription: An augmentation for Missile Launchers which increases shield damage and recoil control, but reduces accuracy.

precision-barrel-adjuster.name: Precision Barrel Adjuster
precision-barrel-adjuster.longDescription: An augmentation which increases the accuracy of any ranged weapon.

pyrocket-quickloader.name: Pyrocket Quickloader
pyrocket-quickloader.longDescription: This Pyrocket-specific augmentation increases ammo capacity, reduces reload times and reduces overall volume, albeit at the cost of reduced accuracy and damage to shields.

pyrocket-supercharger.name: Pyrocket Supercharger
pyrocket-supercharger.longDescription: A Pyrocket-specific augmentation that increases damage output and fire rate, but at the cost of reload time and increased volume.

quick-release-trigger.name: Quick-release Trigger
quick-release-trigger.longDescription: An augmentation which increases the rate of fire of any ranged weapon.

quickloader.name: Quickloader
quickloader.longDescription: An augmentation which reduces the reload time of any ranged weapon.

rafiq-snubnose-disruptive-coating.name: Rafiq Snubnose Disruptive Coating
rafiq-snubnose-disruptive-coating.longDescription: This Rafiq Snubnose-specific augmentation improves the stopping power and shield disruption effect of the pistol while reducing overall volume, but at the cost of ammo capacity and reload time.

rafiq-snubnose-expander.name: Rafiq Snubnose Expander
rafiq-snubnose-expander.longDescription: This Rafiq Snubnose-specific augmentation increases the ammo capacity of the pistol at the cost of recoil and increased overall volume.

rafiq-snubnose-heavy-kit.name: Rafiq Snubnose Heavy Kit
rafiq-snubnose-heavy-kit.longDescription: An augmentation for the Rafiq Snubnose heavy pistol which focuses on improving the stopping power of the gun, but makes it harder to handle.  This increases the damage and headshot damage of the gun at the cost of reducing the fire rate.

rafiq-snubnose-quickdraw-assembly.name: Rafiq Snubnose Quickdraw Assembly
rafiq-snubnose-quickdraw-assembly.longDescription: An augmentation for the Rafiq Snubnose which reduces recoil and reload time and improves accuracy but reduces overall stopping power.

rafiq-snubnose-sprayer.name: Rafiq Snubnose Sprayer
rafiq-snubnose-sprayer.longDescription: An augmentation for the Rafiq Snubnose which increases the weapon's fire rate at the cost of shield damage.

rafiq-snubnose-marksman.name: Rafiq Snubnose Marksman
rafiq-snubnose-marksman.longDescription: A Rafiq Snubnose-specific augmentation which grants a significant bonus to range and some added recoil control — but reduces magazine size.

recoil-adjuster.name: Recoil Adjuster
recoil-adjuster.longDescription: An augmentation which reduces the recoil of any ranged weapon.

tactical-enhancer.name: Tactical Enhancer
tactical-enhancer.longDescription: An augmentation which increases the headshot damage of any ranged weapon.

vulcan-gau-92-disruptive-coating.name: VULCAN GAU-92 Disruptive Coating
vulcan-gau-92-disruptive-coating.longDescription: This VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation increases shield damage output and overall damage output, but reduces accuracy and increases recoil and reload times.

vulcan-gau-92-expander.name: VULCAN GAU-92 Expander
vulcan-gau-92-expander.longDescription: A VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation which increases ammo capacity and improves reload times at the cost of accuracy, damage output, and overall volume.

vulcan-gau-92-focuser.name: VULCAN GAU-92 Focuser
vulcan-gau-92-focuser.longDescription: An augmentation for the VULCAN GAU-92 which increases range and accuracy and reduces recoil, however rate of fire is reduced.

vulcan-gau-92-sprayer.name: VULCAN GAU-92 Sprayer
vulcan-gau-92-sprayer.longDescription: A VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation which increases rate of fire, but reduces effective range and accuracy.

vulcan-gau-92-accelerator.name: VULCAN GAU-92 Accelerator
vulcan-gau-92-accelerator.longDescription: A VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation which increases accuracy, recoil control, and reload speed at the cost of its shield damaging capabilities.

aggressive-grip-adjuster.name: Aggressive Grip Adjuster
aggressive-grip-adjuster.longDescription: A melee weapon augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to attack, but increases the stamina cost to block.

blade-flexi-coating.name: Blade Flexi-Coating
blade-flexi-coating.longDescription: An augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to block of any melee weapon.

blade-grip-adjuster.name: Blade Grip Adjuster
blade-grip-adjuster.longDescription: An augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to attack of any melee weapon.

blade-optimizer.name: Blade Optimizer
blade-optimizer.longDescription: A melee weapon augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to block and attack, but reduces damage.

blade-sharpener.name: Blade Sharpener
blade-sharpener.longDescription: An augmentation which increases the damage output of any melee weapon.

defensive-grip-adjuster.name: Defensive Grip Adjuster
defensive-grip-adjuster.longDescription: A melee weapon augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to block, but increases the stamina cost to attack.

edge-optimizer.name: Edge Optimizer
edge-optimizer.longDescription: A melee weapon augmentation which increases damage, but increases stamina cost to attack.

heavy-blade-adjuster.name: Heavy Blade Adjuster
heavy-blade-adjuster.longDescription: A melee weapon augmentation which increases damage, but increases stamina cost to block.

lightweight-adjuster.name: Lightweight Adjuster
lightweight-adjuster.longDescription: A melee weapon augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to attack and overall volume, but reduces damage output.

blade-blood-grooves.name: Blade Blood Grooves
blade-blood-grooves.longDescription: An augmentation, for any melee weapon, which reduces weight and stamina cost but reduces damage.

heavy-metal-blade-coating.name: Heavy Metal Blade Coating
heavy-metal-blade-coating.longDescription: An augmentation which increases the damage output of any melee weapon while greatly increasing its weight.

garment-reinforcement.name: Garment Reinforcement
garment-reinforcement.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which increases armor value.

blade-warding-weave.name: Blade-warding Weave
blade-warding-weave.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces blade damage taken, but increases dart damage taken.

woven-reinforcement.name: Woven Reinforcement
woven-reinforcement.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces blade damage taken, but increases poison and fire damage taken.

concussive-dampening.name: Concussive Dampening
concussive-dampening.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces concussive damage taken, but increases energy damage taken.

concussive-redirection.name: Concussive Redirection
concussive-redirection.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces concussive damage taken, but increases dart damage taken.

dart-proof-latticing.name: Dart-proof Latticing
dart-proof-latticing.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces dart damage taken, but increases overall volume.

penetrative-reinforcement.name: Penetrative Reinforcement
penetrative-reinforcement.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces dart damage taken, but increases blade damage taken.

energy-dispersing-padding.name: Energy Dispersing Padding
energy-dispersing-padding.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases concussive damage taken.

energy-resistant-weave.name: Energy Resistant Weave
energy-resistant-weave.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

curative-infused-padding.name: Curative-infused Padding
curative-infused-padding.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases fire damage taken.

detoxifying-fabrics.name: Detoxifying Fabrics
detoxifying-fabrics.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases energy damage taken.

flame-resistant-fabrics.name: Flame-resistant Fabrics
flame-resistant-fabrics.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces fire damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

desert-tested-weave.name: Desert-tested Weave
desert-tested-weave.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which increases heat protection, but increases overall volume.

radiation-absorbing-fabrics.name: Radiation Absorbing Fabrics
radiation-absorbing-fabrics.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up and fire damage taken, but increases blade and dart damage taken. This augmentation cannot be applied to Radiation Suits.

radiation-shielded-latticing.name: Radiation Shielded Latticing
radiation-shielded-latticing.longDescription: An augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up, but increases overall volume.

protective-coating.name: Protective Coating
protective-coating.longDescription: An augmentation which removes the durability loss incurred when suffering defeat.
